title: Replace custom mobile and collapsed Admin sidebar behavior
goal: Deliver one accessible mobile Admin drawer and accessible collapsed navigation without internal full reloads or background body scrolling

in: ADMUX-0102 and findings AUX-IA-003, AUX-IA-004, AUX-IA-005, AUX-IA-007
Admin sidebar mobile, collapsed, focus, navigation, and scope-density behavior

acceptance_criteria: Admin uses one accessible mobile drawer with Escape, focus containment/restoration, and background scroll locking
Collapsed navigation controls and destinations have accessible names and remain keyboard reachable
Internal navigation uses Next.js client routing rather than full-page location assignment
Persistent scope chrome consumes less vertical height without obscuring the acting context
Focused accessibility, navigation, lint, admin-audit, and control-plane checks pass with evidence recorded
Canonical audit status is not promoted without its required dependency and immutable evidence

evidence: Admin audit registry and execution validation passed: 79 findings, 362 spec tasks, 20 workflows, 18 launch gates, 27 evidence receipts (2026-09-10).
Control-plane validation passed with pre-existing RELEASE-001 warning and 0 errors (2026-09-10).

progress.summary: Implemented the accessible mobile Admin drawer and collapsed-navigation hardening; local focused verification passes, while canonical ADM-B13 remains unpromoted pending governed external evidence.
completed: Radix mobile Sheet is explicitly modal and restores focus to its trigger on close.
Collapsed navigation controls and destinations retain accessible names and Next client routing.
Admin audit baseline/generated artifacts are refreshed and audit validation passes.
Accessibility contract coverage passes for the modal drawer, focus restoration, named collapsed controls, and client navigation.
next_steps: Obtain required VoiceOver/TalkBack and governed ADM-B13 evidence before promoting the task.
Apply the owner-approved core-flow gate: automated checks, keyboard/focus coverage, and governed assistive-technology evidence, targeting WCAG AA.
blockers: Canonical ADM-B13/ADMUX-0102 promotion remains gated on dependency-ready immutable and external evidence; local checks alone are insufficient.
